name: naolab
description: Scripts raíz (Sonar, calidad, etc.); apps en frontend/ y backend/

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.test: npm run test --prefix backend && npm run test --prefix frontend
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage --prefix frontend && npm run test:coverage --prefix backend
scripts.sonar: npm run test:coverage && npm run sonar:prefix && npm run sonar:scan
